aaIntelligenceIndex.label: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
aaIntelligenceIndex.notes: Uses the current v5.0.1 suite for every model. Values are the publisher's rounded integer headline scores. Highest listed commonly used effort is selected. Live-page asOf is observation date, not a claimed evaluation-run date.

aaCodingAgentIndex.label: Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index
aaCodingAgentIndex.notes: Equal-weight composite of FrontierCode v1.1 Main, Terminal-Bench 4.0 and SWE-Atlas-QnA-AA. Publisher's embedded fractional indexScore is expressed on its displayed 0-100 integer scale. Each result names the agent, effort, agent versions and any observed safety fallback. Its Terminal-Bench 4.0 component is not reported as a Terminal-Bench 4.1 score.

terminalBench.label: Terminal-Bench
terminalBench.notes: Only official 4.1 leaderboard entries, using the published accuracy field. No 4.0, 2.1 or 2.0 results substituted. asOf uses the entry's updated_at date. Model/agent release-date metadata is not an evaluation date.

sweBenchPro.label: SWE-Bench Pro V2 Full
sweBenchPro.version: V2 Full public split (642 tasks; revision 2026-09-22)
sweBenchPro.notes: Current SWE-bench-family public comparison selected. All values use V2 Full, never V2 HARD, original Pro, private Pro or SWE-bench Verified. Highest effort actually listed for each model is retained; some are below the model's maximum supported effort. Harness version and individual run date are unpublished. asOf is observation date. Quantitative evidence establishing which SWE-bench-family benchmark is currently 'most cited' was not found.
